propositions: Coverage tracing is collected redundantly on three identical Ubuntu Python cells (3.11, 3.12, 3.13), adding 34 seconds of wall-clock runner occupancy per cell without distinct verdicts because production code has no version branches.

Ubuntu Python 3.13 should be designated the primary cell for coverage collection while Python 3.11 and 3.12 remain as uninstrumented behavioral-compatibility legs; macOS 3.13 remains an uninstrumented control.
All four matrix cells (Ubuntu 3.11/3.12/3.13, macOS 3.13) must retain both default-tier and integration-tier pytest execution; only Ubuntu 3.13 should receive the coverage instrumentation flags.

The workflow contract must enforce that Ubuntu 3.13 receives both coverage flags (--cov and --cov-report) while the other three cells receive neither, validated by a held-out test in test_ci_workflow_parity.py.
OSS precedent (Django, NumPy, SciPy) confirms selective coverage on a primary or dedicated configuration is accepted practice; no project found has documented rejection of this pattern.

Post-merge runner savings should be measured by comparing Ubuntu 3.11 and 3.12 default-suite step durations before and after this change, with the umbrella ticket inedible-subsimious-brahmancow tracking the first post-merge observation.
